channel.description: Latest articles from The Times of Israel (timesofisrael.com)

item.title: Sa’ar to represent Israel at inaugural Board of Peace meeting, after PM declines to attend
item.description: Saudi Arabia says it can't commit funds to Gaza's reconstruction without more information about IDF pullout and disarmament of Hamas, hopes Thursday's DC meeting will bring clarity The post Sa’ar to represent Israel at inaugural Board of Peace meeting, after PM declines to attend appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: IDF strikes gunmen who approached troops in north Gaza after emerging from tunnel
item.description: In 'blatant' truce violation, military says at least 5 armed terror operatives entered damaged building on Israeli side of ceasefire line before being targeted in airstrike The post IDF strikes gunmen who approached troops in north Gaza after emerging from tunnel appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Syrian FM: Security talks with Israel are focused on buffer zone, not Golan Heights
item.description: Asaad al-Shaibani clarifies negotiations are about IDF presence in border areas that Israeli troops entered after Assad regime's overthrow, says control of Golan 'is another issue' The post Syrian FM: Security talks with Israel are focused on buffer zone, not Golan Heights appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: PM and Trump reportedly agree to ‘full force’ economic pressure campaign against Iran
item.description: Blocks on Iranian oil exports to China among options, US official tells Axios; Geneva to host next round of US-Iran talks, though second American official sees 'zero chance' of deal The post PM and Trump reportedly agree to ‘full force’ economic pressure campaign against Iran appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Two men shot and killed hours apart amid scourge of violent crime in Arab community
item.description: 18-year-old killed in Nazareth, while man killed and another wounded in Negev highway shooting, bringing number of victims this year to 47 in just 45 days The post Two men shot and killed hours apart amid scourge of violent crime in Arab community appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Meet the settlers of Instagram, the photogenic West Bank women documenting pastoral life
item.description: As the war of opinion rages on amid an Israeli-Palestinian ceasefire, these influencers beyond the Green Line seek to win hearts and minds while documenting their rustic lifestyles The post Meet the settlers of Instagram, the photogenic West Bank women documenting pastoral life appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Netanyahu didn’t push Trump to slam Herzog over pardon, PM’s office claims
item.description: Israeli president's office had reportedly sought clarification on whether premier was behind US leader saying Herzog 'should be ashamed of himself' for not yet pardoning Netanyahu The post Netanyahu didn’t push Trump to slam Herzog over pardon, PM’s office claims appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Palestinians report 8 killed in overnight IDF airstrikes on Gaza
item.description: No comment from army, which said yesterday that gunmen approached troops in ceasefire violation * IDF says it targeted Hezbollah arms depots, rocket launchers in Lebanon strikes The post Palestinians report 8 killed in overnight IDF airstrikes on Gaza appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Mansour Abbas says foreign-linked actors pressured him to ally with Netanyahu in 2021
item.description: Ra'am party head hints that Qatar wanted PM in power over perceived dovishness on Hamas; Bennett reacts by claiming 'Sinwar preferred Netanyahu because Netanyahu is good for Hamas' The post Mansour Abbas says foreign-linked actors pressured him to ally with Netanyahu in 2021 appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Crew headed by Jewish American Jessica Meir arrives at International Space Station
item.description: Team of 4 astronauts replaces crew that was hit by station's first medical evacuation: 'Up here, there are no borders and hope is universal' The post Crew headed by Jewish American Jessica Meir arrives at International Space Station appeared first on The Times of Israel.
